description: Pharmaceutical R&D portfolio management. Activities represent therapeutic area investments. High scope costs reflect the capital intensity of drug development. Epistasis blocks: {Oncology-Solid, Oncology-Heme, Immunology} immuno-oncology cluster, {Neuroscience, Cardio-Metabolic, Rare-Disease} chronic disease cluster, {Gene-Therapy, mRNA-Platform, Vaccines} platform technology cluster, {Biosimilars, Anti-Infectives, Ophthalmology} specialty cluster.
learning_objectives: Understand R&D portfolio strategy under high capital costs
Observe how therapeutic area synergies (epistasis) reward focused strategies
Experience patent cliff shocks and pipeline disruption events
See how different firms converge on similar therapeutic niches (strategic groups)
